title: retrieval: validation suite & CI gates (recall/latency)
description: Create canonical retrieval corpus and query set; implement CI benchmark computing Recall@10, MRR@10, embedding-dim checks, and p95 latency; add gating thresholds and nightly drift detection job. Include integration test for options hot-reload effect on query results.
